command: grep -rl -iE 'yank' docs/ release-checklists/ CHANGELOG.md README.md | while read f; do grep -iE 'yank' "$f" | grep -viqE 'yanked (numpy|upstream)' && echo "$f"; done | sort
note: The grep also matches release-checklists/0.8.1-receipts/rollback.json, which is the previous release's evidence rather than a policy statement, so it is not counted. 0.8.1's receipt named '0.8.0.md, 0.7.0.md and README.md'; on this tree 0.8.0.md is the pivoted 0.8.2.md, and the 'README.md' it meant is release-checklists/README.md -- the repository root README contains no yank statement, on this tree or on release/0.8.1.
result: 3 policy documents state the yank-not-delete rollback policy on this tree: release-checklists/0.7.0.md, release-checklists/0.8.2.md and release-checklists/README.md
